_comment: Guardrail budgets enforced by CI. Only the Director may raise these, with a DECISIONS.md entry explaining why.

playerFrameMs._comment: Real players' frame times from telemetry (#373), held by the studio-health watchdog (scripts/playerTelemetry.cjs): a level whose median phone-session p95 frame time over 24 h (3+ sessions) is above touchP95 gets a studio-health issue. 33.4 ms: the VISION bar is 60 fps on a mid-range phone, and a p95 past two vsyncs means visible stutter.

smokeSeconds._comment: Wall time of each CI smoke shard (e2e/shards.mjs), checked by the smoke on CI (#353): 1.5x the slowest CI run on #411 (2026-11-07, the PR depth of #372: four runs, ui and menus one; runs swung up to ~60%), rounded up to 30 s, ui and menus to 120 s; mobile 1.3x. Over budget is a warning; a shard fails only past 1.5x it (scaled up for a slow runner, e2e/shardTime.mjs, #487).

scene._comment: Per-level ceilings checked by the smoke (#188): drawCalls at the ride screenshot (camera-dependent: +20% over the higher of two runs on 2026-10-31; level4 and level5 hold the VISION bar of 250, #260), scene and track (objects named track*) objects and triangles from sceneStats() (camera-independent: +15%). knownOver: "#<open issue>" turns a failure into a warning until that issue lands. Since #925 a target counts only when the rider can shoot it (`sight()`: in view, readable, in sight) on a run played as a player (3 hits a game second), and `bossFramedShare` is the least share of the boss fight with a shootable weak point. Levels 1–5 re-set on 2026-11-23 from their first CI run under that count (seed 1337): the longest gap +1 s and the share +2 points up to the next 5% (both a little more where two runs differed), the boss floor 5 points under, down to the next 5%, so nothing gets worse; the targets are 3 s, 10% and 0.6 (#937). title (#376): the title scene, its drawCalls at the two title screenshots, objects and triangles; raised by the Director on 2026-11-09 for the title world (#436 → #454 / #459, DECISIONS "Week 4"): 140 / 130 / 60 000 are ceilings for a dense instanced park, not targets (was 114 / 89 / 11 356 = the 7 Nov scene +20% / +15%). level1 (200: the lift hill's balloon rings in the 10 s shot, #955) and level3 (98: the Ocean ride's first lift looks over the lagoon, #895) raised by the Director on 2026-11-24. level6 raised by the Director on 2026-11-16 (DECISIONS "Week 5"): 130 draws / 160 objects (was 60 / 110, its first smoke before climbers, the Medusa on screen and the fire; #554, #557, #583), still under the VISION bar of 250. level8 (114: 95 draws +20%) set by the Director on 2026-11-26 from the stopped ride frame #1014 samples, where "The Flock!" arrives (#1017; its first ceiling, 93, came from a frame read one early, #959).

pacing._comment: Time with nothing to shoot over a whole run, per level (#450): the smoke's nightly `pacing` step (e2e/pacingMetric.mjs) fails a level whose longest gap with no shootable target on screen (seconds of level time; the first 2 s after GO and the boss tell left out) or share of the run with none is over these. Set on 2026-11-09 from the higher of two local runs per level (seed 1337, 0.5 s steps; a level's longest gap moved up to 2 s between runs, its share up to 5 points): the longest gap +1 s, the share +2 points rounded up to the next 5%, so today's levels pass and nothing gets worse. Lowered for level4 and level5 by the wave placement fix (#451) on the same rule from its measured runs. The Director lowers them further. level7 lowered on the #925 rule from the pacing step on CI once its drone waves came in rings on the rails ahead, each about a second sooner (#950: 48%, longest gap 4.5 s at 33.5 s before the boss, from 46% / 4.5 s at 21 s; the review measured 42% / 2.4 s, seed 1337), its Helicopter (#967, #968) on the #925 rule from the pacing step on CI (shootable 7.0 s of a 17 s fight, 41%, out of sight 9.0 s from 44 s; the review measures 70%: 2.3 s of a 3.3 s fight), with knownOverOnly: "boss" until #989 reaches the 60% target. level1 on the #937 targets (3 s / 10% / boss 60%) once its lift-hill rings and the Blimp's lead through the finale helix met them (review 1.4 s / 6% / 96%, pacing step 2.0 s / 6%, seed 1337). level4 lowered on the #925 rule from its review once its waves held each storyboard stretch, trackside snowmen stood where the terrain doesn't hide them and the Yeti's chest opened half of each roar cycle (5.0 s / 43% / 27%, seed 1337; #937 goes on to the targets). Its boss floor on the #937 target, and the share on the rule from the pacing step, once the Yeti picked and held a ridge with its head low enough in the rider's frame (pacing step 41% / 4.5 s at 20 s / boss 3.5 of 4 s; review 35% / 2.8 s / boss 83%, seed 1337). Then on the rule from the pacing step, the share with CI's margin as level2's, once a small wave came every ~2 s and the roster grew to 42 scouts, 49 snowmen and 22 brutes, each one hit, so a player meets about two a second (#937: pacing step 28% / 3.5 s at 6 s / boss 4.5 of 5 s; review 24% / 3.1 s / boss 3.9 of 5 s, seed 1337; what is left is the lift, pitched at the sky, and the crest over the ice cave's dome). Then the gap on the #937 target and the share on the rule from CI's pacing step once the snowmen sank back into the snow and the waves came denser and wider (#1078; CI on #1078 and #1080: 26–27%, longest gap 2.0 s at 10 s, boss 9.5 of 14 s, beaten at 54 s). level5 lowered on the #925 rule from its review once its waves held each storyboard stretch (embers up the lift, the last ones near enough to clear the volcano's flank, ground lines out on the plain, drakes over the camelbacks) and the Magma Titan sank and climbed out ahead of the rider when the turntable turned it out of view (review 1.8 s / 27% / boss 49%, pacing step 2.5 s / 29% / 64%, seed 1337; the gap on the target; #937 goes on to the share and boss targets). Its 35% held with margin once each wave was a full group (74 embers, 21 imps, 26 golems, 13 drakes), the Eruption rose out of the cone over the drop tower and the Titan climbed out ahead again as soon as it left the frame, not the wider wading bounds (CI's pacing step had measured 32–36% before; after: review 1.9 s / 18% / boss 73%, pacing step 2.0 s / 23% / 64%, seed 1337). Then its share on the rule from the pacing step with CI's margin, and its boss floor on the #937 target, once the Eruption rose low enough to be seen through the flank's hole, the first imps stood on the cone's floor for the drop and two ember spirals came straight down the track ahead of the exit hole (review 1.5 s / 13% / boss 67%, pacing step 1.5 s / 17% / boss 5.5 of 8 s, seed 1337; what is left is the lava tube and the two holes, where the rider sees nothing but straight ahead), and its share again once the Eruption came a second sooner, as the last near embers leave the top of the frame on the lift's approach to the flank (#937: review 1.5 s / 10% / boss 4.0 of 6 s, pacing step 1.5 s / 13% / boss 5.5 of 7 s, seed 1337; the lava tube and the two holes are what is left). Then its share again on the rule from the pacing step, once `sight()` judged an enemy by the middle of what draws it as well as its origin: a golem stands its origin at its feet, and a lava bank hid that point while the golem stood in plain view (#937: pacing step 9% / 1.0 s at 15 s / boss 12.5 of 15 s; review 12% / 1.1 s at 46.6 s / boss 8.4 of 12 s, seed 1337; what is left is the entry hole at 16 s and the fight, where the Titan leaves the frame at ~44 s and ~47 s). It stays at 0.15 once the imps came a second sooner, filling the thin stretch at the entry hole (15–16 s) that CI's pacing step measured as a 2.0–2.5 s gap (#1076, #1078, #1080: 11–14%; local after: pacing step 4% / 0.5 s / boss 13.0 of 15 s, review 3% / no gap of 1 s / boss 8.9 of 10 s, seed 1337): 0.1 once CI's pacing step holds it there, and again once a column of embers ran down the rails into the entry hole in place of the second near spiral, which had left the top of the frame there (CI's pacing step on #1082: 14%, longest gap 2.0 s at 15 s; local after: pacing step 6% / 2.5 s at 55 s in the fight / boss 14.0 of 18 s, review 2% / no gap of 1 s / boss 8.9 of 10 s, seed 1337; what is left is the turntable, 37–39 s, where the car turns away from the last waves). Then on the #937 target once CI's pacing step held it there over two PRs (#1088, #1069: 8%, longest gap 2.0 s at 54 s in the fight, boss 13.0 of 16 s, beaten at 56 s). level3 lowered once its jellyfish came in a small line every 2 s, up the lift and on past the sea stacks: the gap and boss floor on the #937 targets, the share on the #925 rule from the pacing step on CI (13%, longest gap 1.5 s at 7 s, boss shootable 6.5 of 8 s; the review measured 1.0 s / 9% / boss 86%, seed 1337), then its share on the #937 target once lines of 7 held the lift and the sharks and the flying fish each came a second sooner, before the line ahead of them was out of view (#1029: review 4%, no gap of 1 s, boss 83%, seed 1337). level2 lowered by its retimed waves (#937: review 3.3 s / 24% / boss 88%, seed 1337), then by scorpions on the Pyramid passage's floor in the dark ride and a V every 4 s to the boss (#937: review 1.5 s / 10% / boss 88%, pacing step 1.5 s / 10% / 92%, seed 1337; CI's pacing step has measured 5–7 points more share than local runs): the gap on the target, the share at 0.2 for CI's margin, the boss floor on the target. It stays at 0.2 once the lift held a V to the crest, the dark floor ten scorpions and the waves after the airtime crest were trackside scorpions, so the Giant Scorpion is beaten before the final lift turns away from it (#937: pacing step 10% / 1.5 s at 28 s / boss 4.0 of 5 s, beaten at 45 s; review 10% / 1.1 s at 36 s / boss 5.6 of 6 s, beaten at 46 s, seed 1337). Then on the #937 target once CI's pacing step held it there over three PRs (#1076, #1078, #1080: 6–7%, longest gap 1.0–1.5 s at 37 s, boss 4.0 of 5 s, beaten at 45 s). knownOver: "#<open issue>" turns a failure into a warning until that issue lands; with knownOverOnly: "boss" only the boss floor warns. level6 lowered by #945's dust round the Flame through the roll across it and the waves re-timed to it (review 2.2 s / 21%), then by the Medusa's first snakes uncoiling as she starts rising, the rats a second sooner, the lanternflies at 17 s and a pack of 24 at 24 s (#1033: review 1.6 s / 17–18% / boss 74% over two runs, seed 1337): the gap on the #937 target, the share and the boss floor on the #925 rule (+2 points up to the next 5%; 5 points under, down to the next 5%), with no knownOver. CI's pacing step measured 25% on it, so 22 rats on the mats (ahead on the U-turn out of the cave) and a pack of 30 held it (#1038: review 18%, longest gap 1.3 s at 30.6 s, boss 6.5 of 8 s, seed 1337). Then the share and the boss floor on the #925 rule from the pacing step and the review, once the lanternflies' last groups landed 2 s later, through the auto belay's fall to the pit, in 14 groups of 3, and the perched dust (27) and the mats' rats (26) held the cave's entry and the U-turn out of it (#1039: review 6%, longest gap 0.7 s at 16.6 s, boss 7.6 of 10 s; pacing step at 1 s 10% / 2.0 s at 26 s / boss 12.0 of 14 s, seed 1337).

challenge._comment: How hard each level's run is for the model player (#1058, docs/RIDE-KIT.md rule 9): the smoke's `pacing` step (e2e/pacingMetric.mjs `challengeMetrics`, `challengeGate`) fails a level whose base score (its kills' points before the combo multiplier) is over `baseScoreShareMax` of its `maxScore`, whose 90th-percentile second has more than `bunchingP90Max` shootable enemies in one aim-assist circle (44 px of a 720 px view), or whose boss it beats in under `bossSecondsMin` seconds of its fight. `_default` holds every level; a level's own entry overrides it, and `knownOver: "#<open issue>"` turns its failures into a WARN line (its own key: it never excuses a `pacing` ceiling). Started on 2026-11-25 at the #1058 values (0.8 / 2 / 12) with every level over them, measured by the pacing step locally (seed 1337, 0.5 s steps; level6 at 1 s): base score / bunching p90 / boss seconds level1 93% / 6 / 12.0, level2 97% / 3 / 4.5, level3 91% / 7 / 9.5, level4 91% / 4 / 5.0, level5 80% / 3 / 7.5, level6 77% / 2 / 14.0 (at the limits, so excused for CI's margin), level7 85% / 3 / 6.5, level8 100% / 3 / 9.0; #1059 retunes the levels to them, and a level that meets them loses its `knownOver` (level6 after #1093: CI read 76% / 2 / 13.0 s on three PRs; level2 after #1111: pacing step 74% / 2 / 19.0 s, seed 1337, once its Tomb came in waves of two within the flash's reach, its crows flew off from further and more crows came during the Giant Scorpion's fight). Only the Director raises them.
